changes.title: API Gateway: Announcement (November 04, 2026)
changes.detail: Negative backend deadlines are no longer deprecated The deprecation of negative backend deadline values announced on October 23, 2026 is withdrawn. In an OpenAPI 2.0 x-google-backend extension or a gRPC BackendRule , a negative deadline continues to use the default deadline, the same as 0 , and won't be rejected. OpenAPI 3.x backends still reject a negative deadline. For more information, see OpenAPI 2.0 extensions and OpenAPI 3.x extensions .

changes.title: Compute Engine: Feature (November 02, 2026)
changes.detail: Generally available : You can now create C4 sole-tenant nodes on Intel Granite Rapids with the following node types: c4-node-288-576 c4-node-288-1080 c4-node-288-1080-lssd c4-node-288-2232 c4-node-288-2232-lssd For more information, see Sole-tenancy overview .
